comments.author: @MichaelWoodrum
comments.text: I am glad to hear that other people put headphones on, walk around brainstorming and thinking through concepts. I find it is incredibly good for this purpose. The text back and forth is one thing. Actual voice feels real enough and it is always up for a discussion. I tend to think out loud because sometimes hearing myself talk through a problem,or maybe just vocalizing it, activates something else that silent thought does not.

comments.text: Oh that's brilliant, I've been studying Biomimetics since the late 90s, wrote a lot of the Wikipedia page on it and utilise it for much of my work. I have a similar custom instructions on chatGPT although this version is more thorough, which is great to see! I think it's very important to promote Biomimetics as it's one more important reason to look after nature, the universes greatest library. As I like to say somewhat ad nauseum.. "no sane person would burn a library before they even know what books are in there, let alone read them.. so why burn the greatest library of all?" .. comments.author: @fontenbleau
comments.text:
the problem with define prompting is in the tool, the chatGPT is awful after censorship cleansing this year (which proved by research), they destroyed creativity hallucination urge there long time ago. ChatGPT today giving only lists of very distilled boring answers. Creativity in LLM's is the hallucinations basically, but good quality ones. The only good hallucinations of creativity i've seen in Open assistant model, until it was open without registration, kinda they ended this project already. Quality hallucination model is a gold in the pile of mediocre sheet these days (many models copying ChatGPT with it's lack of creativity).
For example asking ChatGPT about future trends, which require quite a creativity, brings a boring list of "bringing Ai into several industries like medical and etc" and other trivial bland ideas without specific details. In Open assistant I received ideas basically like from sci-fi literature of "nano particle controlled dust" and much unique examples, I milked that to the max and saved a list.
Example Open assistant (before it was  closed): "67. Nucleosynthesis Nanosats Scan Universe for Extra Dimensions: Miniaturized devices designed specifically to analyze cosmic ray interactions within Earth’s upper atmosphere discover new particles, pointing toward unknown spatial dimensions beyond the three common ones. Further exploration using purpose-built subatomic probes reveals fascinating phenomena and potential parallel universes, offering fresh perspectives for theoretical physicists seeking a grand unified theory of everything.
